_about: Hand-kept choices for the atlas tools (tools/atlas/match.py reads this). Edit and rerun `python3 tools/atlas/match.py && python3 tools/atlas/index.py`. Area ids are the atlas's (world/atlas/bedlam.json); zones are ours.
_similar: Atlas areas with the same theme as one of our zones but different rooms: the atlas layout replaces ours and our content moves onto it.
_connectors: Roads, plains, wilderness, forests, rivers and seas that join the other zones: open now, with placeholder descriptions where the room is new.
_open_too: Atlas-only areas that open with the connectors although they are not connectors: the city wall (3); the World of Chaos (75) and Ghenna (81), built from the original Ghenna area and opened together, the way to Ghenna running through the World of Chaos; Garathorm's districts written and peopled (the Cathedral 31, the School House 117, Fameland 20, the Vineyard 18); Hommlet's upper rooms (23), the Haunted House and its carnival (82) and Ancalador (79).
_city_annex: Our zones that stay beside the city when the atlas leaves them a free side there (otherwise they too take a connector).
_internal: Our zones that are not places (Limbo, the marquee quest creatures).
_rooms: Room pairings the matcher could not find or got wrong: {atlas id: our vnum} (null: never match this atlas room).
_hookups: Where an ours-only zone joins the atlas world, when the proposal should change: {our zone: {"atlas_room": id, "dir": "north", "zone_room": our vnum}}.
_exits: Ways the atlas lost that an area's original files have, restored by the world build: {room: {dir: room}}. Ghenna's hedge maze and labyrinth of bodies (circle-contrib-areas/ghenna), one-way and looping as first built. The Castle of the Apocalypse's death traps (22181-22209), each a dead end beside its path as in our castle before the re-lay, so the walkway, the pathways, the halls and Ocam's Reach can all be walked.
_sectors: Terrain set by hand where both the atlas and our old world had it wrong: {room: sector}. Dark Haon-Dor's tree, spider web and the Queen spider's den were typed as swimmable water.
_zone_names: A name of our own for a zone whose atlas name does not fit the rooms it ends up with: {zone: name}. The atlas's Great Eastern Desert (area 25) is the desert's river, gorge, waterfall and the caves under the mountain; its sands went to the Sea of Storms (zone 120), where those rooms are still named The Great Eastern Desert.
